text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, "When you have a nosebleed,
pinch your nostrils for about 10 minutes"—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of tapping the back of your head, but
this is the first time I'm hearing of that! Definitely worth a try!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I could get a nosebleed on cue.
Come to think of it, I had a nosebleed once
after running a whole bunch..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whew... haah...
M-My nose isn't bleeding at all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If only I can run more, even more~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much she ran, she never got a nosebleed,
leaving Matikanetannhauser simply exhausted...
